messages:
michelle_support: Heads-up: acme-inc started getting 429s on their dedicated pool right after we moved them to the new 'pro' tier at ~15:17 UTC. They say traffic patterns didn't change. Attaching a short log sample.

raj_infra: please paste the root req_id and a sample response body so I can trace through the rate-service.

sasha_prod: noted they
re on pool-reserved-13 (A100). Observed: normal latency, but immediate 429s. Looks like enforcement in front of the runtime (quota/rate layer).

oncall-bot: autoscale evaluation triggered for pool-reserved-13 at 15:18 UTC; policy min=2 current=2 no scale actions taken.

michelle_support: log snippet from their proxy:
```
2026-03-17T15:20:11Z tenant=acme-inc req_id=rx-9f3a path=/v1/generate tokens=120 model=redwood-v1 status=429 reason=rate_limit key=tenant:acct:12345 rate_profile=standard_minute denom=minute units=60
```

raj_infra: the denom=minute and units=60 look off given the 'pro' plan mapping we expect seconds-based units. Suspect the plan migration path didn't translate legacy denom -> new multiplier. michelle, what time did support call the plan change?

michelle_support: plan migration recorded at 15:17:52 via support ticket #5247. We flipped them to pro there.

michelle_support: quick repro from our infra to staging:
```
for i in {1..300}; do curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hi"}'; sleep 0.2; done
```
Results: 429s kick in after ~45 requests. Expected >500/min for 'pro'.

raj_infra: OK that reproduces. Root cause seems to be migration code skipping denom multiplier update for this legacy plan tag. The tenant is still being enforced on a per-minute baseline that is too low.

sasha_prod: immediate mitigation: set a temporary per-tenant override to lift the limit while infra patches the migration. Also add a watch so we don't confuse autoscaler (autoscale won't help here because enforcement is upstream).

raj_infra: applying override: `POST /admin/tenants/12345/overrides {"rate_limit_units":600}`. Applied at 15:26 UTC.

michelle_support: customer confirms requests now return 200 for the short test window. They've paused their heavy batch runs for 30m per our request.

raj_infra: filing INF-1289: "plan-tag denom translation skipped during migration -> low per-tenant enforcement". Included logs, repro steps, temporary override, and suggested rollback. Marking P1.

michelle_support: customer asked if other tenants might be affected. raj, can you scan recent migrations?

raj_infra: running quick query: `SELECT tenant_id FROM migrations WHERE plan_tag LIKE '%pro%' AND applied_at > now() - interval '24 hours'` to find similar migrations. Will follow up with list.

sasha_prod: add to INF-1289 checklist: reproduce, patch migration code, add e2e migration test for denom conversion, sweep recent migrations, notify any affected accounts.

michelle_support: ETA shared with customer: temporary workaround applied, patch ETA ~4h, monitoring for 2h. I'll update the ticket and account team. :thumbsup:

autoscale-bot: note: queue_depth stayed low; no scale-up scheduled. Reinforcing that this was quota enforcement not capacity.

raj_infra: will land a hotfix and a test to catch this in migration CI. Ping me when you want validation on staging.

michelle_support: thanks all. Closing the immediate support loop with acme-inc. Will re-open if 429s reappear.
